reading-now.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Reading Now' AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

library.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Library' AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

book-store.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Book Store' AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

search.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Search' AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

activate.description: Bring Books to the foreground without opening a book or changing library state.

open-reading-now.description: Select the unique visible Reading Now tab and stop before opening any item.

open-library.description: Select the unique visible Library tab and stop before opening or inspecting any item.

open-book-store.description: Select the unique visible Book Store tab and stop before selecting, sampling, obtaining, or buying an item.

open-search.description: Select the unique visible Search tab and stop before entering a query or selecting a result.

foreground-only.description: Foreground Books without opening an item.

navigate-reading-now.description: Foreground Books and select only the Reading Now tab.

navigate-library.description: Foreground Books and select only the Library tab.

navigate-book-store.description: Foreground Books and select only the Book Store tab.

navigate-search.description: Foreground Books and select only the Search tab.

prohibited: opening or inspecting a book, audiobook, sample, PDF, collection item, or search result
entering a search query or enumerating library, store, recommendation, or result content
obtaining, buying, downloading, deleting, hiding, moving, or sharing an item
changing account, sync, notification, playback, or reading settings
safety.uncertain_outcome: A tab tap may already have changed the visible destination. Inspect only the exact destination tab selector before deciding; never select content or replay blindly.

host: Appium/XCUITest only for declared navigation controls
permissions: locally signed WebDriverAgent only for UI navigation

data_access: visible Books destination-tab control state only
privacy.retention: The integration stores no library, store, recommendation, search, reading, or account data.
privacy.notes: The manifest exposes foregrounding and exact top-level destination tabs only. It does not expose content rows, search entry, item opening, downloads, or purchases.
